Build and optimize enterprise-scale data platforms and pipelines using modern cloud technologies across AWS, GCP, and Databricks. 
Build and optimize ETL/ELT workflows for large-scale data processing and analytics.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field. 
3+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles. 
Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Databricks. 
Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT, and data warehousing. 
Experience with Python, PySpark, or Apache Spark is preferred. 
Good understanding of Data Lake, Data Warehouse, Lakehouse, and modern cloud data architecture concepts. 
Experience with data orchestration tools such as Airflow, AWS Glue, Dataflow, ADF, or similar is a plus. 
Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.
Knowledge of data governance, security, and data quality best practices is an advantage. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
Good English communication skills and ability to work effectively with global teams and stakeholders.
